confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. July is monsoon low season, so accommodation anchors reflect off-season pricing and assume Nepal's VAT and typical hotel service charges are included. Restaurant beer and meal anchors are moderately confident; room anchors, especially the 3-star, are least certain. Cocktail and wine are set at about two times the beer anchor because direct price knowledge is weak, with wine nudged up for import costs. FX value 0.6955 (15 Oct 2026, 4 pm) was reported consistently by two rba.gov.au-restricted searches; the F11.1 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Based on South Asian visitor-district pricing for Thamel/Lazimpat-type areas, with accommodation at July monsoon off-season levels. Cocktail and wine are anchored to the beer anchor (about 2x) per the local price relationship because direct knowledge is weak.
